notes: The number and the team go on the door, as neon-grid-any's fit puts them.
The doors are laid sideways in this texture, 270 degrees on the left and
90 on the right, so number over name on the car is number beside name in
the sheet. The right door is the left mirrored the way this car flips it.
The hockey stick and the twin stripes are dropped. Along the car, on a
door laid sideways, means across the sheet, and the door is already the
number board and the name; a 500 has no second flank panel to carry them.
The sponsors go on the rear quarter, behind the door, along it. On this
car the quarter's island is the whole body side and runs on under the
door, where find_space's largest clean strip was: measured clean, and
drawn under the door's own panel. Its rear third is the part anybody sees.
